guides.title: Workflow: import first, make it game-ready, check, fix
guides.description: How every model goes through Nighty Blender: the person's file in, one question, make_game_ready, then checks and small fixes. No local AI: read this first.

guides.title: Topology and shape rules

guides.title: Organic shapes: import, or build stylized when asked
guides.description: Characters, creatures, plants and rocks: imported from the person's file; how to build stylized ones when the person asks for code.

guides.title: Texturing: materials per part, wear, decals, bake, export
